description: Repositories that build a container image and release it to GHCR on every merged PR.
Use together with the default preset.

packageRules.description: Every FROM is digest-pinned, so upstream rebuilds (security fixes) of an unchanged tag become PRs.
Base-image digest updates: auto-merge without waiting time (equivalent to the former daily Dependabot run without cooldown). The PR build + smoke test is the gate.
Anything that ends up in the image is a fix: the merge creates a patch release, which ansible-docker.lan picks up.
Python runtime dependencies end up in the image as well.
